text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we live, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias: if the data used to train AI contains unfair patterns, the system may treat certain groups unequally. Fairness requires careful checking and correction of these mistakes. Privacy is another issue, as AI often collects large amounts of personal information, so clear rules are needed to protect people. Transparency matters too—users should understand why an AI makes a decision, especially in areas like healthcare or hiring. Ultimately, responsible AI development means building systems that are safe, honest, and respectful of human values, with regular oversight and accountability at every step.
